- **Rule check**: The supply-chain report and the 13G/A meet none of the conditions R1~R6 (source: `state.probability_adjustment_rules`).
- **Probability-weighted value**: 0.30 × 76.3 + 0.50 × 24.1 + 0.20 × 3.3 = 35.60 → **$36** (unchanged) · band **$36~$121** · center **$68** (source: `state.valuation`).
- **Versus reference price**: 68 ÷ 137.36 − 1 = **−50%** (previously −51%, reflecting only the price change) (source: `state.valuation.upside_vs_price_basis`).
- **Risk-free rate memo**: The U.S. 10-year yield is 5.15% (2026-11-13). This is +16bp versus the 4.99% input in the November issue, and the discount rate will be recalculated in the monthly run (12/01) (source: [FRED DGS10](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DGS10) · `data/latest.json meta.macro.ust10`).
- **29 milestones**: 24 in progress · 4 unjudged · 1 missed. A line for this run was added to `status_history` for all 29 (source: `state.scorecard`).
